definition: a man who is meticulous about his looks.
example: ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ದೊಡ್ಡ ನಾಜೂಕುಗಾರ, ಸದಾ ಅಂದವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He is a great dandy, always looking meticulous about his appearance.

definition: a white, crystalline substance, sodium chloride, NaCl, with a characteristic taste, made from sea water, etc., and used for seasoning and preserving foods, etc.; common salt.
example_en: She added a little salt to the cooking.

definition: to have life, as an organism; to be alive.
example_en: A human cannot live without air.

definition: the act of charging with a fault, wrong-doing or crime; accusation; indictment; imputation.
example: ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಅವನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಳ್ಳತನದ ಆಪಾದನೆ ಹೊರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The police leveled an accusation of theft against him.

definition: the short stumps of grain, corn, etc., collectively, left standing after harvesting; stubble.
example_en: After harvest, stubble remained in the field.

definition: a queen.
example_en: The queen arrived on the royal elephant.

definition: a variety of campātree (Magnoliaceae family).
example_en: The shade of the round campā tree had fallen in the courtyard.

definition: a thin, sharp piece of wood; a splinter.
example_en: He used a needle to remove the splinter.

definition: the quality of being very excellent.
example_en: That institution achieved great excellence in business.

definition: the hot sun-light.
example_en: In the hot sunlight of summer the people ran to the shade.

definition: that which is within reasonable limits; moderateness.
example_en: Maintaining moderation in speech is a good quality.

definition: ending with a grammatical inflection.
example_en: There is a lesson in grammar about words ending with an inflection.

definition: to regain consciousness after a brief period of stupor, unconsciousness, etc.
example: ಮೂರ್ಛೆ ಹೋದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತಿಗೆ ಮೆಯ್ದಿಳಿದನು.
example_en: After fainting, he regained consciousness after a while.

definition: to argue for one's rival or against a subject, issue or cause.
example_en: In the meeting he argued in favour of his rival.

definition: the work, profession of a goldsmith.
example_en: He was very skilled in the goldsmith's craft.

definition: (usu. said of political parties) a group of persons having, in common among themselves, thoughts, mission of liberal or radical changes in the system; a school of such thoughts or a mission (now, tis is being applied to marxism oriented people).
example_en: The leftist workers gave speeches at the meeting.

definition: the period or time when discharge of menses occurs in a woman.
example_en: During her menstrual period, she takes rest.

definition: a man totally or partially unable to hear; a deaf man.
example_en: Being a deaf man, he was speaking through signs.

definition: to perceive, comprehend and understand completely.
example_en: He perceived and understood the teacher's words completely.

definition: to become very angry; to be infuriated, enraged.
example_en: Hearing the news of the defeat, he became very angry.

definition: (dial.) a flat plank at the centre of a potter-wheel on which earthenwares are shaped.
example: ಕುಂಬಾರ ಅಣಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟು ಪಾತ್ರೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The potter placed the clay on the wheel-plank and shaped the pot.

definition: to ask someone earnestly; to entreat humbly; to implore.
example: ಬಡವನು ರಾಜನನ್ನು ಚಾಲವರಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The poor man implored the king and asked for help.

definition: any of a number of heterocyclic, colourless, crystalline, bitter organic substances having alkaline properties and containing nitrogen, found in plants used as drugs and stimulants; an alkaloid.
example: ಆ ಗಿಡದಿಂದ ತೆಗೆದ ಕ್ಷಾರಾಭವನ್ನು ಔಷಧವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The alkaloid extracted from that plant is used as a medicine.

definition: a female Jaina, religious mendicant.
example: ಆ ಗಂತಿ ಜೈನ ಮಠದಲ್ಲಿ ತಪಸ್ಸು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That Jaina nun was performing penance in the monastery.

definition: to behave in arrogant or overbearing manner; to be haughty.
example_en: Because of his wealth he was behaving haughtily before people.

definition: to show honour; to treat with respect; to respect.
example_en: Everyone should treat elders with respect.

definition: to bang heavily.
example_en: He banged his fist heavily on the table.

definition: the music produced by playing a fluit.
example_en: The flute music of the cowherd was heard in the forest.

definition: a hall or building where governmental deliberations are officially held; a court.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಚಾವಡೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಊರಿನ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತಿದೆ.
example_en: The old court hall still stands in the middle of the village.

definition: (mus.) a mode (more popularly called as Karnāṭaka kāpi), in Karnāṭaka system, having all the seven notes in both ascending and discending orders, but having a mutative course while ascending, derived from Kharaharapriya.
example: ಆಕೆ ಕಚೇರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಪಿ ರಾಗವನ್ನು ಸುಶ್ರಾವ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She sang the Kapi raga melodiously at the concert.

definition: to cover with a cloth, lid, veil, etc.; to conceal; to shroud.
example_en: She covered her face with the end of her sari.

definition: to be trampled; to be trodden heavily.
example_en: He was trampled in the crowd.

definition: any of various strong, thin, plain-woven cotton cloth; muslin.
example_en: She wore a muslin saree.

definition: a short note written on a piece of paper.
example_en: She sent me a short note.

definition: the creeper Caesalpinia bonduc of Caesalpiniaceae family.
example_en: The gaduga creeper had spread near the fence.

definition: a malignant wound.
example_en: That malignant wound did not heal quickly.

definition: the act of applying light touches or strokes to (a person or part of a person's body) so as to excite the nerves and usu. produce laughter and spasmodic movement; tickle; a tickling.
example_en: She tickled the foot.

definition: to be excited by joy, love, success, etc.; to be carried away by such events.
example_en: On hearing the news of victory, everyone was carried away with excitement.

definition: contrary to the constitution of a state; not in conformity with the constitutional principles or system of government; anti-constitutional.
example: ಆ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸೈಂವಿಧಾನಿಕ ಎಂದು ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ತೀರ್ಪು ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The court ruled that the law was unconstitutional.

definition: the act of pounding.
example_en: The pounding of the rice began early in the morning.

definition: dirty; soiled, unclean.
example_en: Those dirty vessels need to be washed well.

definition: a kind of shrubby plant.
example_en: A mūmai shrub has grown behind the house.

definition: to have a crack, split or fissure.
example_en: The dried wall slowly developed a crack.

definition: a variety of musk.
example_en: A variety of musk is available in the shop.

definition: to concur; to consent; to agree.
example_en: Everyone in the meeting consented to that proposal.

definition: a joke; a jest.
example_en: Everyone laughed hearing his joke.

definition: (pl.) position and reputation or dignity.
example_en: He had a good position and dignity in society.

definition: to muiltiply a number or quantity from another; to increase a number or quantity by a specified times.
example_en: The teacher taught the children to multiply numbers.

definition: to have a hollow place in the stem or a branch; to have a hole or holes.
example_en: The tree branch broken by the wind developed a hollow.

definition: to hold, seize firmly.
example_en: He held the rope firmly.

definition: a smiling expression of the face.
example_en: The baby's smiling expression captivated the mother's heart.

definition: the effect or effects of strict abstinence from food, on mind.
example_en: The effect of strict abstinence from food was seen in him after the fast.

definition: the chief meal of the day; dinner or lunch.
example: ರೈತರು ದಿನದ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯವಸಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಕುಳಿತರು.
example_en: The farmers finished the day's work and sat down for the chief meal.

definition: the quality of being appropriate, fit, proper.
example_en: Everyone liked the appropriateness of this attire.

definition: the eye that is large and round.
example_en: Her large round eye was shining in the sunlight.

definition: to join (two or more things, persons) together.
example: ಅವನು ಎರಡು ಹಗ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ನೆರಹಿ ಒಂದು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He joined two ropes together and made one.

definition: the creeper Flagellaria indica of Flagellariaceae family; forest moon creeper.
example: ಪನಂಬುಬಳ್ಳಿ ಕಾಡಿನ ಮರಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಬ್ಬಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The forest moon creeper grows by climbing over the trees in the forest.

definition: a goldsmith's profession.
example_en: Grandfather was an expert in the goldsmith's profession.

definition: to make a fabric, esp. on a loom, by interlacing threads or yarns; to weave.
example_en: She wove a silk sari on the loom.

definition: a water jar.
example_en: The priest filled the water jar with holy water.

definition: very small; tiny; diminutive.
example: ಆ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸೀರು ಗೊಂಬೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a tiny doll in that box.

definition: to change one's perpendicular position and lean or incline on; to slant.
example_en: The tree leaned to one side in the wind.

definition: to make believe; to make a false show of; to pretend; to feign.
example_en: The child pretended to be sleeping.

definition: the poison secreted by some snakes, spiders, insects, etc., introduced into the body of the victim by a bite or sting.
example: ಹಾವು ಕಚ್ಚಿ ಅವನ ಮೈಗೆ ವಿಷ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The poison spread through his body after the snake bit him.

definition: the act of speaking.
example_en: Her manner of speaking was gentle and clear.

definition: Kailāsa, the snow-clad mountain.
example_en: It is believed that Shiva resides on the snow-clad mountain Kailasa.

definition: (psych.) the condition of being autochthonous; autochthonism.
example: ಆ ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟಿನ ಜನರ ಅನ್ಯತ್ರಾರೋಪಿತತೆ ಸಂಶೋಧಕರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The autochthonism of that tribal people caught the researchers' attention.

definition: a mixed breed.
example_en: That animal was born of a mixed breed.

definition: to come out or be produced as an effect of some action, process.
example_en: This effort resulted in a good outcome.

definition: a river.
example_en: A river like the Ganges is the lifeline of this land.

definition: a present given with respect; a respectful gift.
example_en: She gave a respectful gift to the teacher.

definition: to exhale a long breath audibly as from disappointment, in expressing sorrow, longing, etc.; to sigh.
example_en: On hearing the news of defeat, he sighed deeply.

definition: a using of more labour than required; a way of working with unwarranted effort.
example_en: He toiled with unwarranted effort, like the maxim of dravida mantap, for an easy task.

definition: power; strength; might.
example_en: The elephant has extraordinary strength.

definition: he who is worshipped, adored.
example: ಆ ಗುಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇವಿತ ದೇವರ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: In that temple there is the idol of the worshipped god.

definition: to be heated, burned.
example_en: The iron left standing in the sun became heated.

definition: to be ready; to be equipped with.
example_en: The soldiers were equipped and ready for war.

definition: wind blowing from below.
example_en: When the wind blowing from below came, the sea waves rose.

definition: love; affection.
example_en: The love between friends never fades.

definition: the act of levying tax or taxes.
example_en: The king levied taxes on the subjects.

definition: to uproot and eradicate completely.
example_en: The farmers uprooted and eradicated the weeds.

definition: a group or multitude of a large number of people.
example_en: A multitude of people gathered at the fair, filling the place.

definition: a poetical work, written for some gain such as money, position, status, etc.
example: ಆ ಕವಿ ರಾಜನ ಸ್ತುತಿಗಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥಕೃತಿಯೊಂದನ್ನು ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: That poet wrote a work for gain in praise of the king.

definition: he who is liked by gods.
example_en: They praised the king as one beloved of the gods.

definition: a man who is practising medicine; a doctor of medicine; a physician.
example: ಆ ಬೈದೆ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: That physician gave treatment to the village people.

definition: (spirits) to be lost or depressed.
example_en: Hearing the news of defeat, his spirits sank.

definition: abundantly; profusely.
example_en: That year the rain poured down abundantly.

definition: a hard clot of soil.
example_en: Ploughing was difficult because of hard clods of soil in the field.

definition: the virtuous merit gained by supporting or seconding otheṛs good work.
example_en: Merit was gained by supporting his good work.

definition: a horrible hell.
example_en: They say a horrible hell awaits the sinners.

definition: a god; a deity.
example_en: The gods live in heaven.

definition: a thin, sharp piece of wood; a splinter.
example_en: While walking, a splinter pricked his foot.

definition: a smith who works in iron, a blacksmith.
example_en: The blacksmith made iron tools.

definition: to fill completely; to make full.
example_en: He fulfilled everyone's demands.

definition: to put down; to reduce in height, elevation, amount, price etc.
example_en: He lowered his voice and spoke.

definition: something wished for; a wish.
example_en: His wish was fulfilled.

definition: old, worn clothes; rags.
example_en: The poor man wore old, worn-out rags.

definition: the largest, vegetarian, intelligent but shy, and most powerful of the great apes (Gorilla gorilla), native to the jungles of equatorial Africa; gorilla.
example: ಆಫ್ರಿಕಾದ ಕಾಡುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗೋರಿಲ್ಲ ಶಾಂತವಾಗಿ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In the forests of Africa, the gorilla quietly eats plants.

definition: Brahma, the Creator of the universe, who is conceived as having four faces.
example_en: Brahma is called Caturmukha, the four-faced one.

definition: spoken words; speech.
example_en: The teacher's spoken words remained in the disciples' minds.

definition: the act of annoying; annoyance; trouble.
example_en: The father got angry due to the children's annoying trouble.

definition: Viṣṇu, who uses Garuḍa, the king of birds, as his vehicle.
example_en: There is an idol of Vishnu, who rides Garuda, in the temple.

definition: a multitude of persons, esp. of common folks.
example_en: A multitude of common folk had gathered at the fair.

definition: the act of coming; an arriving; arrival.
example_en: The arrival of the teacher brought happiness to the disciples.

definition: a particular unit of measure.
example_en: They bought that cloth in the hachchada measure.

definition: to cause to be spread, distributed over or pervade throughout a relatively large area.
example_en: The wind spread the fragrance throughout the whole garden.

definition: a three-legged stool of low height; a tripod.
example_en: Grandmother lifted the low three-legged stool and brought it inside.

definition: a good, noble deed.
example_en: That saint had performed many good, noble deeds.

definition: a group of people assembled to rejoice drinking liquors.
example_en: All the friends gathered and arranged a drinking party.

definition: a quivering, quaking.
example_en: A quivering arose in his body out of fear.

definition: a formal contest of skill in reasoned argument, with two teams taking opposite sides of a specified question; a debate.
example_en: The students participated in the debate today.

definition: a man versed in the art of singing or composing songs.
example: ಆ ಗೀತಿವಿದ ಹೊಸ ಕೀರ್ತನೆಯನ್ನು ರಚಿಸಿ ಹಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That man versed in the art of singing composed a new devotional song and sang it.

definition: a length of a hollow pipe of glass, rubber or metal, for conveying fluids; a tube.
example: ಗಾಜಿನ ಲಳಿಗೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಔಷಧಿ ದ್ರಾವಣ ಸಾಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They conveyed the medicine solution through a glass tube.

definition: an oil-like extract got from the seeds of cashew.
example_en: The oil-like extract is obtained from the cashew seed.

definition: happening, coming, resulting henceforth.
example_en: The changes that came henceforth became known to everyone.

definition: a climbing up, as mounting on the back of a horse, elephant etc.
example_en: Mounting onto the horse's back was not easy.

definition: the act of coming; arrival.
example_en: The arrival of the guests brought joy to everyone.

definition: a man appointed for striking a gong once in every twenty-four minutes.
example: ಘಟಿಕಾಪ್ರಹಾರಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಗಂಟೆಗೊಮ್ಮೆ ಜಾಗಟೆ ಬಾರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The gong-striker strikes the gong once every four hours.

definition: the act of stitching, sewing.
example_en: The stitching of that shirt has been done well.

definition: work got done from or to be done by, (unskilled or manual) labourer in return for payment made daily or weakly.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಕೂಲಿಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿಯೇ ಜೀವನ ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That family survives only by doing daily-wage labour.

definition: the site of a battle.
example_en: The soldiers sacrificed their lives at the battlefield.

definition: a dried piece of thin splint.
example_en: He lit the fire with a dried piece of thin splint.

definition: to cause to inhale (a medicinal powder, snuff etc.) through the nostril.
example: ವೈದ್ಯನು ರೋಗಿಗೆ ನಸ್ಯಂಗುಡುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಔಷಧಿ ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The doctor gave the patient medicine by causing him to inhale it through the nostril.

definition: derived by reasoning; concluded or judged from premises or evidence.
example_en: That conclusion was derived by reasoning from the evidence.

definition: joy; pleasure; delight.
example_en: He found joy in the children's play.

definition: any sport played in or on water; water-sport.
example_en: Swimming is the main event in water-sports.

definition: a outerwear made of leather; a leather-coat.
example_en: He wore a leather-coat during winter.

definition: to come or be lying across, as to cause an obstacle; to impede.
example: ನೀರಿನ ಕಾಲುವೆಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಅಡ್ಡಗಿಸಿ ಹರಿವನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The wood lay across the water channel and blocked its flow.

definition: to come to an end; to cease.
example_en: The rain finally came to an end.

definition: dysentry caused by the vitiated phlegm.
example_en: The doctor gave medicine for the dysentery caused by vitiated phlegm.

definition: the nozzle of a water-vessel.
example_en: The nozzle of the water-vessel broke off.

definition: the state of having stunted growth.
example: ಆ ಮರದ ನರಚಲು ನೀರಿನ ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: The stunted growth of that tree was due to lack of water.

definition: not bearable; intolerable; unendurable.
example_en: That pain was unbearable.

definition: to appear, manifest in front of; to come on the way (as an obstacle); to become an obstacle.
example_en: A huge boulder appeared as an obstacle on the way.

definition: sound; noise.
example_en: The sound of the thunder was heard throughout the town.

definition: a cluster of things that are naturally grown together; a bunch.
example_en: A bunch of bananas hung from the mango tree.

definition: a long tube of clay, concrete, metal, plastic, etc., for conveying water, gas, oil, etc.; a pipe.
example: ಮನೆಗೆ ನೀರು ತರಲು ಹೊಸ ಧಮನಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They installed a new pipe to bring water to the house.

definition: a piece of land higher than its adjacent land; a natural elevation of land.
example_en: The whole valley was visible from that elevated ground.

definition: a system of paying the tax amount in instalments on particular dates.
example_en: The farmers paid the tax under the instalment system.

definition: a poet of merit.
example: ಆ ಒಳ್ಗವಿ ಬರೆದ ಕಾವ್ಯ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಗಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The poem written by that fine poet won everyone's praise.

definition: a slight, imitative sound.
example_en: A slight sound was heard inside the hut.

definition: the medium to large sized, ever-green tree Carallia lucida (= C. integerrima) of Rhizophoraceae family.
example_en: The Carallia lucida tree had grown large in the forest.

definition: the science of language, including phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax, and semantics; linguistics.
example_en: She is studying linguistics at the university.

definition: balance due of the revenue.
example_en: The balance due of revenue was still remaining on the farmer.

definition: along the edge or border.
example_en: The bus moved slowly along the edge (of the rail line).

definition: a sword drawn out from its sheath.
example_en: The drawn sword glittered and flashed in his hand.

definition: a string of gold or silver for wearing round the neck; a necklace.
example_en: They made her wear that necklace on the wedding day.

definition: a preparation of tobacco taken into nostrils by inhalation; snuff.
example_en: The old man inhaled snuff into his nostrils.

definition: an acute, contagious viral disease, caused by the varicella zoster virus, usu. of young children, characterised by fever and eruption of blisters on the skin and mucous membranes; chicken-pox.
example: ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಜೋಳಮೈಲಿ ಬಂದು ದೇಹದ ತುಂಬೆಲ್ಲ ಗುಳ್ಳೆಗಳು ಎದ್ದವು.
example_en: The child got chicken-pox and blisters broke out all over its body.

definition: immediately; soon; at once.
example_en: He came home immediately.

definition: (pl.) collectively, five spices - black pepper, coriander; cumin seed; mustard, and fenugreek.
example_en: She added the five-spice mixture to the dish to enhance its aroma.

definition: to become abundant, superfluous.
example_en: The grain became superfluous and overflowed in the warehouse.

definition: an indeclinable used to express abhorrence, detestation, deep repugnance, etc.
example: ಕೊಳಕು ಬಟ್ಟೆ ನೋಡಿ ಅವನು ಛಿಃ ಎಂದನು.
example_en: Seeing the dirty clothes, he exclaimed "chih" in disgust.

definition: the act of applying light touches or strokes to (a person or part of a person's body) so as to excite the nerves and usu. produce laughter and spasmodic movement; tickle; a tickling.
example_en: The friends tickled each other and laughed.

definition: a variety in cardamom plant; black cardamom plant.
example_en: The black cardamom plant is used for medicine.

definition: a wound in which pus has developed and is about to burst.
example: ಗಾಯ ಈಗ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಾಯ ಆಗಿ ಒಡೆಯುವ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.
example_en: The wound has now become a pus-filled sore about to burst.

definition: (gram.) a sentence consisting of two or more independent, coordinate clauses or short sentences; a compound sentence.
example_en: The teacher gave an example of a compound sentence.

definition: an artificial path for directing the water flow; a canal.
example_en: They dug a canal to direct water to the field.

definition: the act or art of engraving letters, designs on a gold article, plate, etc.

definition: a variety of cocoanut tree.
example: ಆ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧುತೆಂಗು ಎಂಬ ವಿಶೇಷ ತೆಂಗಿನ ತಳಿಯಿದೆ.
example_en: There is a special variety of coconut called madhutengu in that garden.

definition: something given as a reward, present, etc.; a gift.
example: ಶಾಲೆಯ ಕಟ್ಟಡಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅವರು ದೊಡ್ಡ ದೇಣಿಗೆ ನೀಡಿದರು.
example_en: They gave a big gift/donation for the school building.

definition: the act or an instance of floating.
example_en: A leaf was floating on the water.

definition: a kind of fig tree.
example_en: The fig tree was growing beside that rock.

definition: (a female animal) to have an offspring developing in the uterus.
example: ಆ ಹಸು ಈಗ ತೆನೆತೀವಿ ಕರುವನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: That cow has now conceived and is carrying a calf.

definition: (pl.) good qualities or characteristics.
example_en: Everyone liked his good qualities.

definition: to make late; to slow up; to delay.
example_en: He delayed the meeting.

definition: approached; drawn or came near (to).
example: ಆ ಮಹಾತ್ಮನ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಜನರು ಉಪಚರಿತರಾಗಿ ಬಂದರು.
example_en: People came, having approached near that great man.

definition: an instrument consisting essentially of a lens or combination of lenses, for making very small objects, as microorganisms, look larger so that they can be seen; a microscope.
example_en: The students viewed the cells through the microscope.

definition: the vine Piper nigrum of Piperaceae family.
example_en: Black pepper is grown mostly in the hilly regions.

definition: along with; together with.
example_en: She went to the movie along with her friends.

definition: the large, evergreen tree Manilkara hexandra ( = Mimusops hexandra) of Sapotaceae family.
example_en: The shade of the Manilkara tree is very cool.

definition: he who talks interestingly, charmingly.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರಸಕ್ತ ತನ್ನ ಮಾತುಗಳಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಸೆಳೆದನು.
example_en: That charming talker captivated everyone with his words.

definition: mutual hatred or ill-will; enmity; hostility; antipathy.
example: ಎರಡು ಮನೆತನಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಪಗೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was old enmity between the two families.

definition: an excellent or eminent man.
example_en: All the people of the town respected that eminent man.

definition: a variety in sugarcane.
example: ಕೆಳವಾಡಿ ಕಬ್ಬು ಬೇಗ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಜಾತಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿದೆ.
example_en: The kelavadi sugarcane belongs to a fast-growing variety.

definition: a narrow, upright, pointed stake used in fences; a picket; a pale.
example_en: They had put up a fence of pointed pickets around the field.

definition: of or characteristic of a race; of or between races.
example_en: Racial conflict was occurring in that region.

definition: a leaf of a plant.
example_en: The leaf of the plant dried and fell down.

definition: pulled out by roots.
example_en: That tree was pulled out by its roots.

definition: miscellaneous, sundry expenses.
example_en: The sundry expenses were entered in the accounts.

definition: a man who washes clothes, linens, etc., for hire; laundryman.
example: ಧೋಬಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವಾರ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಗೆಯಲು ಬರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The laundryman used to come every week to wash the clothes.

definition: a variety of mango tree.
example: ನಮ್ಮ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೈತಲೆಮಾವಿನ ಮರ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಫಲ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The baitale-mavu mango tree in our orchard bears fruit well.

definition: a form that is exactly similar.
example_en: This statue is an exact copy of the original.

definition: kept; placed; put.
example_en: That object was kept placed in the box.

definition: to fall across.
example_en: The child slipped and fell across the floor.

definition: a thorn in the flesh of a foot.
example_en: While walking, a thorn pierced his foot.
